description: Java class LogView extending TextView, implementing LogNode interface, used for displaying log data received through the LogNode interface in an Android application.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView for outputting log data received via LogNode interface, with chainable logging capability.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats and outputs log data, including priority, tag, message, and throwable, to the LogView and forwards to next LogNode if present.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line in the LogView.
